items.question: Is this pickup only?
items.answer: Yes. Hamptons Burgers offers pickup orders only through the app. Place your order, then pick it up at the restaurant when it’s ready.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Checkout and payment happen securely in Toast Online Ordering. You can pay with a card (and Apple Pay when Toast offers it) during checkout.

items.question: How do I see past orders or reorder?
items.answer: Sign in with your Toast guest account when ordering. From there you can view order history and reorder previous meals.

items.question: How will I know when my order is ready?
items.answer: Toast will show your estimated pickup time at checkout. Follow any confirmation emails or texts from Toast for updates.

items.question: Can I note allergies or special requests?
items.answer: Use the special instructions field in Toast checkout when available, and mention allergies clearly. For serious allergies, call the restaurant as well.
